## Load session

See the data load template in the parent directory.

Also used, by namespace: `ape`, `cba`, `pheatmap`, `gtable`, `jsonlite`
(download of the NCBI lineages only) and `GenomicBreaks` (last section).

```{r load}
library(ScrambledTreeBuilder)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
load("primates.benchmark.RData")
```

## Define clades of interest

### Pick some clades of interest and color them on the tree

Clade information is stored in a list.  A `colorClades` object is created, and
can be added to tree plots to color them.

```{r clades}
makeCladeList <- function(Tibble) FocalCladeList(
  Cercopithecidae = focalClade(Tibble, "29_Papio_anubis_GCF_000264685",       "29_Nasalis_larvatus_GCF_000772465",   "#377EB8", "Cercopithecidae"),
  Hominidae       = focalClade(Tibble, "00_Homo_sapiens_GCF_000001405",       "15_Pongo_abelii_GCF_028885655",       "#4DAF4A", "Hominidae"),
  Hylobatidae     = focalClade(Tibble, "19_Hoolock_leuconedys_GCF_047372625", "19_Hylobates_pileatus_GCF_021498465", "#984EA3", "Hylobatidae"),
  Platyrrhini     = focalClade(Tibble, "43_Saguinus_midas_GCF_021498475",     "43_Pithecia_pithecia_GCF_028551515",  "#FF7F00", "Platyrrhini"),
  Strepsirrhini   = focalClade(Tibble, "74_Lemur_catta_GCF_020740605",        "74_Nycticebus_coucang_GCF_027406575", "#A65628", "Strepsirrhini")
)

allFocalCladeLists <- lapply(trees, makeCladeList) |> S4Vectors::SimpleList()
clades <- allFocalCladeLists$P

visualizeTree(Tibble) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(paste("Tree built with 100 - Percent Identity and labelled with node ID")) + clades

results$focalClade <- results$focalColor <- NULL
results <- recordClades(results, clades)
```

## Heat map and comparison with the NCBI Taxonomy (Figure 2)

### Heat map

Rows and columns ordered by UPGMA (average linkage) on the distance matrix,
with the leaf order optimised by `cba::order.optimal`.  Row labels: species
name in italics and assembly accession.  `GC[AF]`: the IDs of GenBank-only
assemblies may start with either prefix.

```{r heatmap_functions}
species_name <- function(ids) gsub("_", " ", sub("_GC[AF]_[0-9.]+$", "", sub("^[0-9]+_", "", ids)))
accession_of <- function(ids) sub("^.*_(GC[AF]_[0-9.]+)$", "\\1", ids)

# plotmath expressions, which pheatmap passes to grid
pretty_labels <- function(ids)
  as.expression(Map(function(s, a) bquote(italic(.(s)) ~ .(paste0("(", a, ")"))),
                    species_name(ids), accession_of(ids)))

treeHeatMap_ <- function(pairwise_matrix, clades, treeheight_row = 100, ...) {
  d  <- as.dist(pairwise_matrix)
  hc <- hclust(d, method = "average")
  co <- cba::order.optimal(d, hc$merge)
  hc$merge <- co$merge
  hc$order <- co$order

  annot <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(pairwise_matrix))
  for (clade in names(clades)) {
    annot[clades[[clade]]@genomeIDs, "clade"] <- clades[[clade]]@displayName
    annot[clades[[clade]]@genomeIDs, "color"] <- clades[[clade]]@color
  }
  annot <- annot[order(annot$clade), ]
  color_annot <- na.omit(unique(annot[, c("clade", "color")]))
  color_list  <- list(clade = color_annot$color)
  names(color_list$clade) <- color_annot$clade

  pheatmap::pheatmap(pairwise_matrix, cluster_rows = hc, cluster_cols = hc,
    annotation_row = annot[, "clade", drop = FALSE], annotation_names_row = FALSE,
    annotation_colors = color_list, labels_row = pretty_labels(rownames(pairwise_matrix)),
    show_colnames = FALSE, treeheight_row = treeheight_row, treeheight_col = 0,
    cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 12, border_color = NA, ...)
}
```

### NCBI Taxonomy lineages

Taxon of each genome from its assembly accession, and full lineage of the
taxon, from the NCBI Datasets v2 API.  The table is downloaded only when
`primates_ncbi_lineages.tsv` is absent or lacks a genome of the matrix; delete
the file to update it to the current state of the NCBI Taxonomy.  Columns:
`genome_id`; `accession`, as found at NCBI; `taxid`; `lineage`, `name [rank]`
joined by ` > `, root excluded.

```{r lineages}
ncbi_lineages <- function(ids, api = "https://api.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/v2") {
  get <- function(path) {
    Sys.sleep(0.4)                                    # NCBI: at most 3 requests per second without a key
    jsonlite::fromJSON(paste0(api, path), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  }
  batches <- function(x, size) split(x, ceiling(seq_along(x) / size))

  # Neither the GCF/GCA prefix written in the IDs (GCF is also written for
  # GenBank-only assemblies) nor the version (some do not exist at NCBI) is
  # reliable: ask for both prefixes without version (NCBI returns the latest
  # version), and match on the digits, preferring the same version.
  stopifnot(all(grepl("_GC[AF]_[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", ids)))
  digits  <- sub("^.*_GC[AF]_([0-9]+)\\.[0-9]+$", "\\1", ids)
  dig_ver <- sub("^.*_GC[AF]_([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)$", "\\1", ids)
  queries <- sort(unique(c(paste0("GCA_", digits), paste0("GCF_", digits))))
  found <- character()                              # taxid, named by accession
  for (b in batches(queries, 20))
    for (r in get(paste0("/genome/accession/", paste(b, collapse = ","), "/dataset_report?page_size=100"))$reports)
      found[r$accession] <- as.character(r$organism$tax_id)
  acc_dig_ver <- sub("^GC[AF]_", "", names(found))
  accession <- vapply(seq_along(ids), function(i) {
    hit <- c(names(found)[acc_dig_ver == dig_ver[i]], names(found)[sub("\\..*$", "", acc_dig_ver) == digits[i]])
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  }, "")
  if (anyNA(accession)) stop("no genome report for ", paste(ids[is.na(accession)], collapse = ", "))
  taxid <- found[accession]

  tax <- list()                                     # taxonomy reports, named by taxid
  fetch_taxa <- function(taxids) {
    for (b in batches(sort(setdiff(taxids, names(tax))), 50))
      for (r in get(paste0("/taxonomy/taxon/", paste(b, collapse = ","), "/dataset_report"))$reports)
        tax[[as.character(r$taxonomy$tax_id)]] <<- r$taxonomy
  }
  fetch_taxa(unique(taxid))
  fetch_taxa(setdiff(unique(as.character(unlist(lapply(tax, `[[`, "parents")))), "1"))

  lineage <- vapply(taxid, function(t) {
    path <- c(setdiff(as.character(unlist(tax[[t]]$parents)), "1"), t)
    paste(vapply(path, function(p) sprintf("%s [%s]", tax[[p]]$current_scientific_name$name,
                                           tolower(if (is.null(tax[[p]]$rank)) "no rank" else tax[[p]]$rank)), ""),
          collapse = " > ")
  }, "")
  data.frame(genome_id = ids, accession = accession, taxid = as.integer(taxid), lineage = unname(lineage))
}

lineage_file <- "primates_ncbi_lineages.tsv"
genomes <- rownames(matrices_symmetric$percent_difference_global)
if (!file.exists(lineage_file) || !all(genomes %in% read.delim(lineage_file)$genome_id))
  write.table(ncbi_lineages(genomes), lineage_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
lin <- read.delim(lineage_file)
file.mtime(lineage_file)                            # date of the NCBI Taxonomy snapshot
```

### Comparison of the UPGMA tree with the NCBI Taxonomy

NCBI taxa are compared with the UPGMA tree as sets of genomes.  Only the taxa
with at least 2 of the genomes, but not all, are informative; taxa with the
same genomes are merged under one name (`A [rank] = B [rank]`).  A taxon is
recovered when its genomes form a clade of the tree (`ape::is.monophyletic`).
Each clade of the tree (root excluded) is classified as:

- `ncbi`: it is an NCBI taxon;
- `contradicts`: it shares genomes with an NCBI taxon but neither contains the
  other;
- `resolves`: neither; it resolves a node that the NCBI Taxonomy leaves
  unresolved (for example _Homo_ + _Pan_).

```{r ncbi_functions}
compare_ncbi <- function(m, lin) {
  stopifnot(all(rownames(m) %in% lin$genome_id))
  lineage <- strsplit(lin$lineage, " > ", fixed = TRUE)[match(rownames(m), lin$genome_id)]
  names(lineage) <- rownames(m)
  n <- length(lineage)

  upgma <- ape::as.phylo(hclust(as.dist(m), method = "average"))

  taxa    <- unique(unlist(lineage))
  members <- lapply(setNames(taxa, taxa), function(t) names(lineage)[vapply(lineage, function(l) t %in% l, TRUE)])
  members <- members[lengths(members) >= 2 & lengths(members) < n]
  set_id  <- vapply(members, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = ","), "")
  ncbi    <- members[!duplicated(set_id)]
  names(ncbi) <- tapply(names(members), set_id, paste, collapse = " = ")[set_id[!duplicated(set_id)]]

  compatible <- function(a, b) { k <- length(intersect(a, b)); k == 0 || k == length(a) || k == length(b) }
  status <- function(x) {
    if (any(vapply(ncbi, setequal, TRUE, x))) "ncbi"
    else if (!all(vapply(ncbi, compatible, TRUE, x))) "contradicts"
    else "resolves"
  }
  clades <- lapply(ape::prop.part(upgma), function(i) upgma$tip.label[i])
  clades <- clades[lengths(clades) >= 2 & lengths(clades) < n]

  list(upgma = upgma, ncbi = ncbi,
       recovered = vapply(ncbi, function(x) ape::is.monophyletic(upgma, x), TRUE),
       status = status, clades = clades, clade_status = vapply(clades, status, ""))
}

print_ncbi_comparison <- function(cmp) {
  s <- table(factor(cmp$clade_status, levels = c("ncbi", "resolves", "contradicts")))
  cat(sprintf("NCBI taxa with at least 2 genomes (all genomes excepted): %d; recovered as UPGMA clades: %d\n",
              length(cmp$ncbi), sum(cmp$recovered)))
  if (any(!cmp$recovered)) cat("Not recovered:", paste(names(cmp$ncbi)[!cmp$recovered], collapse = "; "), "\n")
  cat(sprintf("UPGMA clades: %d; NCBI taxa: %d; resolving NCBI polytomies: %d; contradicting NCBI taxa: %d\n",
              length(cmp$clades), s[["ncbi"]], s[["resolves"]], s[["contradicts"]]))
}
```

```{r ncbi_comparison}
cmp <- compare_ncbi(matrices_symmetric$percent_difference_global, lin)
print_ncbi_comparison(cmp)

# NCBI taxa
data.frame(taxon = names(cmp$ncbi), genomes = lengths(cmp$ncbi), recovered = cmp$recovered, row.names = NULL)

# Clades of the tree that are not NCBI taxa
other <- cmp$clade_status != "ncbi"
data.frame(status = cmp$clade_status[other],
           species = vapply(cmp$clades[other], function(x) paste(unique(species_name(x)), collapse = ", "), ""))

# Same topology with the other distance matrices?
distances <- c("percent_difference_global", "percent_difference_local", "P", "P_raw", "JC69", "K80",
               "K80_gap_distance", "F81", "HKY85", "T92", "TN93", "LogDet")
vapply(distances, function(k) isTRUE(ape::all.equal.phylo(
  cmp$upgma, ape::as.phylo(hclust(as.dist(matrices_symmetric[[k]]), method = "average")),
  use.edge.length = FALSE)), TRUE)
```

### Figure 2

On the row dendrogram (the UPGMA tree): filled circle, the clade is an NCBI
taxon, named when its rank is above genus (genus and species names are in the
row labels); open circle, the clade is not an NCBI taxon (it resolves a node
that the NCBI Taxonomy leaves unresolved); red cross, the clade contradicts an
NCBI taxon, drawn only when there is one.  The symbols are explained in the
legend on the right, which replaces the annotation legend of pheatmap and
follows its style (`pheatmap:::draw_annotation_legend`).  Node positions follow
`pheatmap:::draw_dendrogram` (no gaps): x = 1 − height / maximum height / 1.05,
y = 1 − leaf position.

```{r figure2_functions}
treeHeatMap_ncbi <- function(pairwise_matrix, clades, cmp, treeheight_row = 200, fontsize_nodes = 8, ...) {
  fig <- treeHeatMap_(pairwise_matrix, clades, treeheight_row = treeheight_row,
                      annotation_legend = FALSE, silent = TRUE, ...)
  hc  <- fig$tree_row

  # Genomes under each merge of hc, and position of the merge in the row-tree cell
  n   <- length(hc$order)
  pos <- numeric(2 * n - 1)
  pos[1:n] <- 1 / n / 2 + (1 / n) * (match(1:n, hc$order) - 1)
  tips <- vector("list", n - 1)
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
    kids <- hc$merge[i, ]
    tips[[i]] <- unlist(lapply(kids, function(k) if (k < 0) hc$labels[-k] else tips[[k]]))
    pos[n + i] <- mean(pos[ifelse(kids < 0, -kids, n + kids)])
  }
  h <- hc$height / max(hc$height) / 1.05
  node  <- data.frame(x = 1 - h, y = 1 - pos[n + seq_len(n - 1)], size = lengths(tips))
  inner <- which(node$size < n)                                  # root: not tested
  node  <- node[inner, ]

  # cmp must describe the same tree
  key <- function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = ",")
  stopifnot(setequal(vapply(tips[inner], key, ""), vapply(cmp$clades, key, "")))
  node$status <- vapply(tips[inner], cmp$status, "")

  # Names of NCBI taxa above genus: the most inclusive name of the merged ones
  node$label <- ""
  for (k in which(node$status == "ncbi")) {
    hit  <- names(cmp$ncbi)[vapply(cmp$ncbi, setequal, TRUE, tips[[inner[k]]])]
    name <- strsplit(hit, " = ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
    rank <- sub("^.*\\[(.*)\\]$", "\\1", name)
    if (!rank %in% c("genus", "species", "subspecies")) node$label[k] <- sub(" \\[.*$", "", name)
  }

  # Symbols of the nodes, on the tree and in the legend; only the classes present
  symbols <- list(
    ncbi        = list(label = "NCBI taxon",                pch = 21, size = 5, gp = grid::gpar(fill = "black", col = "black")),
    resolves    = list(label = "Not an NCBI taxon",         pch = 21, size = 5, gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = "black")),
    contradicts = list(label = "Contradicts an NCBI taxon", pch = 4,  size = 6, gp = grid::gpar(col = "#D7191C", lwd = 2)))
  shown <- intersect(names(symbols), node$status)

  lab <- node$label != ""
  marks <- do.call(grid::gList, Filter(Negate(is.null), c(
    lapply(shown, function(st) grid::pointsGrob(node$x[node$status == st], node$y[node$status == st],
                                                pch = symbols[[st]]$pch, size = grid::unit(symbols[[st]]$size, "pt"),
                                                gp = symbols[[st]]$gp)),
    list(if (any(lab)) grid::rectGrob(                                # white box behind each name
      x = grid::unit(node$x[lab], "npc") - grid::unit(3, "pt"),
      y = grid::unit(node$y[lab], "npc") + grid::unit(1.5, "pt"),
      width  = grid::unit(1, "strwidth",  as.list(node$label[lab])) + grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      height = grid::unit(1, "strheight", as.list(node$label[lab])) + grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      just = c("right", "bottom"), gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = NA, fontsize = fontsize_nodes)),
    if (any(lab)) grid::textGrob(node$label[lab],
      x = grid::unit(node$x[lab], "npc") - grid::unit(4, "pt"),
      y = grid::unit(node$y[lab], "npc") + grid::unit(2.5, "pt"),
      just = c("right", "bottom"), gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize_nodes))))))

  gt <- fig$gtable

  # Legend on the right of the colour scale, in the column of the annotation
  # legend, in its style: clade colours, then node symbols.
  fontsize <- if (is.null(list(...)$fontsize)) 10 else list(...)$fontsize   # pheatmap's default
  gp   <- grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize)
  gp_b <- grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize, fontface = "bold")
  th   <- grid::unit(1, "grobheight", grid::textGrob("FGH", gp = gp))
  clade_colors <- character()
  for (clade in names(clades)) clade_colors[clades[[clade]]@displayName] <- clades[[clade]]@color
  clade_colors <- clade_colors[order(names(clade_colors))]
  key <- list()
  y <- grid::unit(1, "npc")
  for (section in c("clade", "tree node")) {
    key <- c(key, list(grid::textGrob(section, x = 0, y = y, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, gp = gp_b)))
    y <- y - 1.5 * th
    for (it in if (section == "clade") names(clade_colors) else shown) {
      symbol <- if (section == "clade")
        grid::rectGrob(x = 0, y = y, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, width = 2 * th, height = 2 * th,
                       gp = grid::gpar(col = NA, fill = clade_colors[[it]]))
      else
        grid::pointsGrob(x = th, y = y - th, pch = symbols[[it]]$pch,
                         size = grid::unit(symbols[[it]]$size, "pt"), gp = symbols[[it]]$gp)
      text <- if (section == "clade") it else symbols[[it]]$label
      key <- c(key, list(symbol, grid::textGrob(text, x = 2.4 * th, y = y - th, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, gp = gp)))
      y <- y - 2 * th
    }
    y <- y - 1.5 * th
  }
  width_of <- function(txt, gp)                        # one grob per label: grobWidth of a vector is the first's
    do.call(grid::unit.c, lapply(txt, function(t) grid::grobWidth(grid::textGrob(t, gp = gp))))
  texts <- c(names(clade_colors), vapply(symbols[shown], `[[`, "", "label"))
  at <- gt$layout[gt$layout$name == "legend", ]        # colour scale; the next column is for annotation legends
  gt$widths[at$l + 1] <- max(2.4 * th + max(width_of(texts, gp)),
                             max(width_of(c("clade", "tree node"), gp_b))) + grid::unit(4, "pt")
  gt <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(gt, grid::gTree(children = do.call(grid::gList, key)),
                                t = at$t, b = at$b, l = at$l + 1, clip = "off", name = "legend_clade_node")

  cell <- gt$layout[gt$layout$name == "row_tree", ]

  # Room on the left for the names of the deepest nodes
  if (any(lab)) {
    widest <- node$label[lab][which.max(nchar(node$label[lab]))]
    gt <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(gt, grid::unit(1, "grobwidth",
            grid::textGrob(widest, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize_nodes))), pos = 0)
    cell$l <- cell$l + 1
  }
  gt <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(gt, grid::gTree(children = marks), t = cell$t, l = cell$l,
                                clip = "off", name = "ncbi_marks")

  fig$gtable <- gt
  fig
}

# Size of the figure in inches (all widths and heights of the layout are
# absolute when cellwidth and cellheight are set), to open a device that fits it.
figure_size <- function(fig) {
  grDevices::pdf(NULL); on.exit(grDevices::dev.off())
  c(width  = grid::convertWidth(sum(fig$gtable$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE),
    height = grid::convertHeight(sum(fig$gtable$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
}
```

```{r figure2_build}
fig2 <- treeHeatMap_ncbi(matrices_symmetric$percent_difference_global, clades, cmp,
                         main = "Percent nucleotide difference")
(fig2_size <- figure_size(fig2))
```

```{r ANI_Matrix, fig.width=fig2_size[["width"]], fig.height=fig2_size[["height"]], dev=c("png", "svg")}
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(fig2$gtable)

pdf("primates_clustering.pdf", width = fig2_size[["width"]], height = fig2_size[["height"]])
grid::grid.draw(fig2$gtable)
invisible(dev.off())
```

### Benchmark with million-contig genomes

Alignment of _Cercopithecus mitis_ (GCF_028627265.1) to the human genome
(GCF_000001405.29), seed RY128.  When either genome has more than 250 sequence
levels, only the alignments between the 250 sequences of each genome with the
largest aligned width are kept.

```{r million_contigs}
library(GenomicBreaks)
gb <- load_genomic_breaks("/bucket/LuscombeU/common/ScramblingInTheTree/AlignedGenomes/3.0/RY128/pairgenomealign_benchmark/results_29_Cercopithecus_mitis_GCF_028627265.1/alignment/29_Cercopithecus_mitis_GCF_028627265.1___00_Homo_sapiens_GCF_000001405.29.blasttabplus.gz")

alignment_counts <- function(gb)
  c(alignments = length(gb), target_seqs = length(seqlevels(gb)), query_seqs = length(seqlevels(gb$query)))
alignment_counts(gb)

top_by_aligned_width <- function(gr, n = 250) {
  w <- rowsum(width(gr), as.character(seqnames(gr)))[, 1]
  names(sort(w, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n, length(w)))]
}

if (length(seqlevels(gb)) > 250 || length(seqlevels(gb$query)) > 250) {
  keep_target <- top_by_aligned_width(gb)
  keep_query  <- top_by_aligned_width(gb$query)
  gb <- gb[as.character(seqnames(gb)) %in% keep_target & as.character(seqnames(gb$query)) %in% keep_query]
  seqlevels(gb)       <- seqlevelsInUse(gb)
  seqlevels(gb$query) <- seqlevelsInUse(gb$query)
}
alignment_counts(gb)
seqinfo(gb)
```
